topic.title: Mantis
topic.teaser: Order of insects including praying mantises

easy.title: Mantis
easy.line: Order of insects including praying mantises

easy.text: Mantises are distributed worldwide in temperate and tropical habitats.

medium.title: Mantis
medium.line: Order of insects including praying mantises

medium.text: Mantises are an order of insects that contains over 2,400 species in about 460 genera in 33 families.
Mantises are among the insects most commonly kept as pets.
